article_notes: Zagreb university clinic; 31 B. canis dogs (smear; subspecies by PCR), 18 complicated, 13 uncomplicated; 16 healthy controls. Cytokine samples taken 6-8 h after imidocarb on day 1, and on day 7. One complicated dog died (no mortality comparison). Table 2 'Diseased day 7' rows repeat the 'Complicated day 7' values (apparent table error; not used). p values in the text differ slightly from Table 2 (table values used; text values in notes). Within-group cytokine-haematology correlations (Table 3) are not severity comparisons and were not extracted. Small groups; authors warn of type 1 error. Same Zagreb centre as other B. canis cohorts; overlap with other papers not stated.

severity_definitions.label: complicated vs uncomplicated babesiosis
severity_definitions.definition: Complicated babesiosis classified on clinical and laboratory data following the WHO malaria classification; main complications SIRS (>=2 of 4 criteria) and MODS (>=2 of renal creatinine >180 umol/l, hepatic ALT >176 and AP >360 IU/l, respiratory pulmonary oedema or dyspnoea, muscular CPK >600 IU/l). 66% of complicated dogs had MODS, all of them SIRS positive. 1 complicated dog died before day 7.
severity_definitions.quote: On the basis of clinical manifestations and laboratory data the infected dogs were classified into two subgroups: complicated (18 dogs, 8 Female, 10 Male) and uncomplicated (13 dogs, 5 Female, 8 Male).
severity_definitions.definition_source: WHO malaria classification; SIRS and MODS criteria
